commands.native:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Native consumer qualification only; run after successful MPC key preparation.
cd /Users/jehyuk/repo/Tokamak-zk-EVM/packages/backend
run_root=/tmp/tokamak-mpc-native-e2e-optimized-BMRiqX
crs="$run_root/crs"
library="$run_root/inputs/subcircuits/library"
fixture="$run_root/inputs/synthesizer"
for name in tau_sequence.rkyv prover_keys.rkyv preprocess_keys.rkyv verifier_keys.rkyv crs_provenance.json; do
  test -s "$crs/$name"
done
cmp "$library/setupParams.json" ../frontend/qap-compiler/subcircuits/library/setupParams.json
export TOKAMAK_VERIFIER_KEYS="$crs/verifier_keys.rkyv"
cargo build --locked --offline --release -p preprocess --features local-development-subcircuit-library 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/build-preprocess.log"
/usr/bin/time -l cargo run --locked --offline --release -p preprocess --features local-development-subcircuit-library -- \
  --subcircuit-library "$library" --keys "$crs" --synthesizer-stat "$fixture" \
  --device cpu --output "$run_root/preprocess" 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/preprocess.log"
cargo build --locked --offline --release -p prove --features local-development-subcircuit-library,timing 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/build-prove.log"
/usr/bin/time -l cargo run --locked --offline --release -p prove --features local-development-subcircuit-library,timing -- \
  --subcircuit-library "$library" --tau-sequence "$crs/tau_sequence.rkyv" --keys "$crs" \
  --synthesizer-stat "$fixture" --device cpu --output "$run_root/prove" 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/prove.log"
cargo build --locked --offline --release -p verify --features local-development-subcircuit-library 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/build-verify.log"
/usr/bin/time -l cargo run --locked --offline --release -p verify --features local-development-subcircuit-library -- \
  --preprocess "$run_root/preprocess/univariate_verifier_preprocess.bin" \
  --proof "$run_root/prove/univariate_proof.bin" --instance "$fixture/instance.json" --timing 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/verify.log"
rg --line-regexp 'true' "$run_root/verify.log"
VERIFY_TEST_PREPROCESS="$run_root/preprocess/univariate_verifier_preprocess.bin" \
VERIFY_TEST_PROOF="$run_root/prove/univariate_proof.bin" \
VERIFY_TEST_INSTANCE="$fixture/instance.json" \
cargo test --locked --offline --release -p verify --features local-development-subcircuit-library \
  --test local_fixture -- --ignored --exact accepts_real_proof_and_rejects_tampering --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$run_root/tamper.log"
